neighbours.label: Nuclear-plant water and fuel storage: the nouns for where reactor fuel or cooling water is held (spent fuel pool, storage tanks, reactor water level) in a reactor-accident context; quiet on the same nouns elsewhere (swimming pool, fuel tank) and on nuclear topics without them

quiet: Helicopters dropped supplies to the villages cut off by the flood.
